description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Moonstone Eulogist's last ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
